<!-- modify this form HTML and place wherever you want your form -->
<form 
  action="https://formspree.io/f/xnjjaybd" 
  method="POST"
>

  <label>
    name<br>
    <input 
      type="name" 
      name="name" 
      required>
  </label>
  
  <label>
    email<br>
    <input 
      type="email" 
      name="email" 
      placeholder="your@email.com"
      required>
  </label>

  <label>
    message<br>
    <textarea name="message" rows="6" required></textarea>
  </label>

  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
